headline: UPDATE to totw-20261025-1500-01 (Hebron operation) -- IDF says it operated in 400+ West Bank locations and arrested 40
dek: The Israeli military said it operated in more than 400 locations across the occupied West Bank over the weekend and arrested 40 Palestinians it said were affiliated with Hamas or Palestinian Islamic Jihad. Hebron municipal officials said 200-300 families were displaced overnight from Deir Bahha…
sources: Israeli military statement via Mathrubhumi English (AFP inputs); operation scale corroborated by Al Jazeera/Haaretz
fault_line: Security operation ahead of an election vs collective punishment: does a 400-location sweep two days before the vote protect voters or punish Hebron's civilians?

sections.what_happened: The Israeli military said it operated in more than 400 locations across the occupied West Bank over the weekend and arrested 40 Palestinians it said were affiliated with Hamas or Palestinian Islamic Jihad. Hebron municipal officials said 200-300 families were displaced overnight from Deir Bahha and four surrounding areas; Hebron's mayor told Al Jazeera 2,200 people were forced from their homes and the city is under complete blockade. This adds the operation's scale to the 1500-01 record (2,231 displaced, Katz bars return, general closure through election day Oct 27, Netanyahu's 'scale not seen since 1967' vow).
sections.what_verified: The operation and displacement are multi-source (Al Jazeera T2, Haaretz via reporting); the 400-location / 40-arrest figures themselves are IDF-attributed via a single undeclared-tier carrier (Mathrubhumi) and are labelled as the military's claim.
sections.what_disputed: The 400/40 figures are the IDF's own count, not independently verified; displacement figures differ by source (200-300 families per municipal officials vs 2,200 people per the mayor). Hamas has not claimed the Oct 23 Hebron attack; it hailed the killings without claiming credit.
sections.why_matters: 400 locations, 40 arrests, 2,200 displaced — the West Bank operation two days before Israel votes, and the question it raises: security sweep, or election-week punishment?
sections.context: Background: UPDATE to totw-20261025-1500-01 (Hebron operation) -- IDF says it operated in 400+ West Bank locations and arrested 40 Palestinians over the weekend, ahead of Tuesday's election
